additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471348-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/T1170004333] Plug Failure CRM:03288000093
additional_info.body:
Hello Giuseppe,
I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for raising the issue. Sorry for late response. But in the meantime I keep observation this charger and after that troubleshooting no further error occur. I think that was a bug issue.
My opinion is that please update the FW version to avoid such bug issue in future.
If you are not satisfied, I can forward the issue to the region to do manual troubleshooting of those converters associated with outlet 1.
Let me know your decision please.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
